en.speciesInfo: Guess what? "Geep" is the name for an animal that has features of both a sheep and a goat. In 1984, scientists made one. They put together the starting cells of a baby sheep and a baby goat. A geep's coat is patchy. Some parts are fluffy like a sheep, and some parts have hair like a goat. A baby born to a sheep and a goat is also called a geep. But that is very, very rare. Two animals in one body. Isn't that amazing?
